New Features:

+ Settings tabs now switch automatically when they receive focus from keyboard or Yatse navigation, matching mouse hover behavior.

Bugfixes:

- Replaces the bright separator lines with very thin dark-gray Cumination-style lines.

- Moves the Release Notes border from the change-text area to the outside edge of the Release Notes window.

- Keeps Settings closed after Create, Update and Prüfen actions finish instead of reopening the dialog.
